en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad urban street lined with multi‑story historic buildings and trees. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and in the street, and there is a prominent church tower with a clock rising on the right side in the distance. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in German identifying the scene as Bismarckplatz and Herrengasse in Graz.
